description: local-review: feature context at session start, a check before an agent acts as a human, and a reminder to open a review round. Each hook does nothing if lr isn't on PATH.

hooks.command: command -v lr >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec lr hook session-start
command -v lr >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec lr hook pre-tool-use
command -v lr >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec lr hook stop
